verdicts.reason: The two are nearly identical and both have the same problems. The logo is crammed against the top-left edge, clipped and touching the headline. The coffee bag is shrunk to an unreadable sliver jammed against the right edge, so the hero product is lost. The two-line body copy is tiny at 90 px tall, and the SAVE 15% pill floats on its own above the copy. A spreads the CTA farther right, leaving a wide gap. B pulls the body copy, badge and CTA into a slightly tighter group, but this is only marginally better.
